paragraphs: MealManage is cloud based school nutrition software that the company describes as approved by USDA. The site says the software manages nutrition programs for private, charter and public schools and districts.

For districts and schools the functions listed are mobile POS, online payments, cafeteria menu management with nutritional analysis, meal orders and distribution, inventory and production records, eligibility applications and reports. A caterer account covers multiple school programs, menu management, dashboards and reporting, demand forecast and payments.

Parents use a single dashboard to view menus, pre-order meals, pay online, complete applications and manage allergies, through iOS and Andriod apps. Testimonials are attributed to Randolph Township School District and to Challenge Charter School.

quote.text: MealManage is an USDA approved easy-to-use cloud based online school nutrition software.
